shape.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. An 1-D `int` Tensor. The shape of the desired output.
constraints: The shape of the desired output.
shape must be one of int32, int64, int
When broadcasting, if a tensor has fewer axes than necessary its shape is padded with the appropriate number of zeros.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.

constraints: Two shapes are compatible if for each dimension pair they are either equal or one of them is one.
